tools.name: give_feedback
tools.description:
Report unexpected tool errors, missing capabilities, confusing output, or unclear docs.

        Only message is required. Describe your goal, what you tried, what you expected,
        and any workaround. Feedback is saved for the maintainers to review.

tools.name: list_targets
tools.description:
List OS releases with readable manuals. Required fields: none; call with {}.

        Use product and os_version from a result in get_man_page or search_man_pages.
        An empty list means no current documentation is available.

tools.name: get_man_page
tools.description:
Read a manual. Required fields depend on the retrieval mode:

        1. Name lookup: name. Example: {"name":"ls"}. Optional product pins a distro.
           Without OS/version filters, select the newest upstream version across active catalogs.
           Different packages or sections remain ambig

tools.name: search_man_pages
tools.description:
Find manuals by topic, command prefix or literal option such as --recursive.

        Required field: query, including when continuing a search. All other fields are optional.
        Example: {"query":"compress files"}. Read a result with get_man_page(page_id=...).

        Returns context-preservi
